description.zh: 云消息队列 MQTT 版实例的ID，一定要和客户端实际使用的实例ID匹配。您可以在[控制台](https://mqtt.console.aliyun.com)**实例详情**页面获取该ID。
description.en: The instance ID of ApsaraMQ for MQTT. Must match the instance ID used by the client. Find it on the **Instance Details** page in the [console](https://mqtt.console.aliyun.com).

title.zh: 批量查询客户端在线状态

descriptions.zh:
- **BatchQuerySessionByClientIds**接口的QPS为100。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~163047~~)。
- 每次调用**BatchQuerySessionByClientIds**接口最多查询10个Client ID对应的客户端的在线状态。
- 每成功调用一次**BatchQuerySessionByClientIds**接口，都会计算为一次消息TPS，从而影响您的计费。计费详情，请参见[计费说明](~~52819~~)。
- 考虑到性能影响，**BatchQuerySessionByClientIds**接口使用内部缓存进行查询，可能会导致数据不一致的情况。如需进行精确查询，建议使用[QuerySessionByClientId](~~2603924~~)接口查询。
descriptions.en:
- The **BatchQuerySessionByClientIds** operation supports up to 100 QPS. [QPS limits](~~163047~~).

- Each call queries the online status of up to 10 clients.

- Each successful call counts as one billable transaction. [Billing](~~52819~~).

- This operation queries data from the internal cache and may return stale results. For real-time queries, use [QuerySessionByClientId](~~2603924~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun onsmqtt batch-query-session-by-client-ids --instance-id post-cn-0pp12gl0000 --client-id-list ClientIdList.1 --api-version 2020-04-20 --region cn-hangzhou
